name: Spotify
summary: Keep listening habits private, opt out of ad profiling, and revoke third-party app access.

settings.name: Private Session
settings.impact: Listening history can reveal mood, beliefs, and health concerns. Private Session hides this from followers in real time, though Spotify still logs plays internally.
settings.source: musictechpolicy.com: 'Spotify Privacy Quick Guide'; ExpressVPN Spotify Private Session Guide

settings.name: Tailored Ads
clickPath: Process my personal data for tailored ads
settings.impact: Spotify logs listening habits, searches, device identifiers, and location to build behavioral profiles for advertisers. Opting out limits use of your data for third-party ad targeting.
settings.source: musictechpolicy.com Spotify Privacy Quick Guide; Total Defense security blog

settings.name: Location Permission
settings.impact: Spotify requests location access but music streaming does not require it. Location data is used solely to refine ad targeting. Denying eliminates this collection entirely.

settings.name: Playlist Visibility
settings.impact: Public playlists are searchable and indexed. Research has shown playlists can reveal religion, politics, and mental health status — information you may not want publicly linked to your account.
settings.source: musictechpolicy.com; GeeksForGeeks How to Make Spotify Private

settings.name: Third-Party App Access
settings.impact: Apps authorized via Spotify's API can read your listening history, playlists, and account information on an ongoing basis.
